samir: FYI — Acero Health reached out asking to onboard ARGO-13B for chat + clinical summarization. Requirements: int8 quant, 8k context window, HIPAA-safe (VPC + KMS), target p95 latency <800ms for 512-token responses. They want dedicated capacity and a canary rollout.

lena: Thanks — can you drop a quick sample prompt set and expected QPS? Also is there a preferred accuracy baseline (LLM metric or human eval)? :eyes:

samir: sample prompts attached inline below. QPS initially small (0.5–1 qps), peak could hit ~5 qps. Baseline is current vendor (proprietary) F1 on entity extraction ~0.86; they want parity or better for summaries.

samir: ```
Prompt 1: "Summarize the clinical note for the following visit focusing on diagnoses, medications started, and follow-ups."
Prompt 2: "Extract problem list and recommended next steps from this encounter."
Prompt 3: "Short (3‑4 sentence) patient-facing summary suitable for discharge instructions."
```

mike: For int8 path we'll need to run quant cal/ops on a test A100 and a T4/GPU to compare perf. Dedicated pool sizing: start with 1 node (A100) + 1 T4 for canary. Also need to confirm weight/kv cache memory for 8k context.

anya: Add to the onboarding checklist: eval dataset (50 sample visits), automated regression suite vs current model, latency bench (p95 512 tokens), tokenization parity check, and privacy review. I'll run the eval harness once the sample set is uploaded.

beth: Confirming sales — this is enterprise onboarding (contract signed). Marking high priority. ETA request from customer: 3 weeks for pilot. 

triage-bot: Received. Tagging as `onboard:high`, assigning queue owner = eng-ml. New thread created in onboarding board: https://boards.redwood.ai/boards/ onboard-requests/ARGO-13B-1767770001 :thumbsup:

lena: I'll own ML bring-up. Next steps: (1) get sample set from Acero, (2) run 1-shot int8 conversion + smoke, (3) perf bench on 8k context, (4) run 50-case human eval. Who can provision A100 for the smoke?

mike: I can carve a test A100 node tomorrow. tagging @anya for infra/network isolation steps. Also create an allowlist for Acero's IPs in the VPC.

samir: Perfect. Acero will upload sample set by EOD today. @lena please add a minimal prompt eval harness and share expected artifacts (log format, perf CSV). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT to align. :calendar: 

lena: ack, will post harness link and minimal metrics to the board before the sync. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll prepare a privacy checklist and KMS key provisioning doc.

samir: thanks all — assigning follow-ups on the board.
